messages:
lena: Quick sync — proposing a change to the Roles UI: introduce "entitlement scopes" (org / workspace / project / route) so teams can grant narrow access without creating custom roles.

alex_eng: Hmm, love the idea but worried about UX surface area. If we add scopes we should show inheritance and an override flow. Maybe an "inheritance view" toggle.

maria_product: Enterprise customers will want a way to lock down certain scopes at org level (no override). We need a "force_org_entitlement" flag in the console + API.

kenji_sre: Also needs telemetry: each grant/change should emit events with scope label + principal + actor. Example event keys: `role.grant`, `role.revoke`, `role.override`. Add audit index for fast queries.

tom_security: API enforcement question — will scope be enforced at gateway or at service? Caching policies matter. If gateway does enforcement we need short TTL for policy cache or a revocation webhook.

alex_eng: Suggest we iterate: MVP supports project & org scopes, UI shows effective permissions + a small badge for "inherited". Rollout via feature flag to 10% orgs, then 50%. Do A/B metrics for confusion.

maria_product: Quota mapping: some customers want rate-limits per role-scope. Example mapping we discussed in sync:
```
{
  "scope": "project:proj-123",
  "role": "developer",
  "quota": { "tokens_per_minute": 5000 }
}
```
We need the console to visualize effective quotas.

jenna_design: For UX: collapsed matrix with search, ability to assign by route pattern (eg `/v1/models/*`), and a quick preview panel showing telemetry tags to expect. Avoid bloating main page — put advanced scopes behind an "Advanced" drawer.

sre-bot: Deploy scheduled: permissions-service v3.8 -> canary in clusters west-1 @ 1769904390 :rocket:

lena: Action items: (1) alex -> prototype inheritance view mockups, (2) alex + tom -> decide enforcement layer & cache TTL, (3) kenji -> telemetry event schema, (4) maria -> product PRD for enterprise lock, (5) jenna -> mockups for collapsed matrix. Plan: start 2-week experimental rollout after design review. :thumbsup:
